title: "03 Build and validate the Darwin Core Archive for OBIS"
subtitle: "Event core, Occurrence, eMoF, EML, meta.xml, zip, checks. No upload."
---

```{mermaid}
%%| file: diagrams/obis.mmd
```

## What this does

From the cached export (01) and the reviewed lookup (02): one **Event** per sample (a child event per
acquisition when a sample has several), **Occurrence** rows for validated objects aggregated per event and
taxon, an **extended MeasurementOrFact** with the instrument (NERC L22 URI from the node), the sample volume,
the object count, the concentration where a volume exists and the mean equivalent spherical diameter as
exported, then **EML**, **meta.xml**, a deterministic **DwC-A zip** with a manifest, and the checks.

The upload to the OBIS-USA IPT stays a deliberate manual act by the data owner. Nothing here talks to a portal.

```{r}
#| label: setup
librarian::shelf(dplyr, readr, tibble, arrow, jsonlite, xml2, digest, obistools, here, quiet = TRUE)
for (f in list.files(here("R"), pattern = "\\.R$", full.names = TRUE)) source(f)
PROJECT_ID  <- ecotaxa_project_id()
DATASET_KEY <- paste0("ecotaxa-om-prj", PROJECT_ID)
VERSION     <- format(Sys.Date())
DIR_EXPORT  <- here("data/export", paste0("project-", PROJECT_ID))
DIR_DWCA    <- here("data/darwincore", DATASET_KEY)
objects <- read_parquet(file.path(DIR_EXPORT, "objects.parquet"))
lookup  <- read_taxa_lookup(here("metadata", paste0("taxa_lookup_project-", PROJECT_ID, ".csv")))
meta    <- read_project_meta(here("metadata/projects.csv"), PROJECT_ID)
reg     <- read_measurement_registry(here("metadata/measurement_type.csv"))
project <- ecotaxa_projects() |> filter(projid == PROJECT_ID)
project |> select(projid, title, instrument, instrument_url)
```

## The gate on taxa, and the honest switch

```{r}
#| label: gate
assert_taxa_resolved(objects, lookup)
objects |> count(object_annotation_status)
# the demo project has no validated object: everything is the classifier's prediction. a real publication
# keeps the default (validated only); the demo opts in so the archive is not empty, and every occurrence
# says identificationVerificationStatus = predicted
INCLUDE_PREDICTED <- !any(tolower(objects$object_annotation_status) == "validated")
INCLUDE_PREDICTED
```

## Event, Occurrence, eMoF

```{r}
#| label: tables
event      <- dwc_event(objects, DATASET_KEY)
occurrence <- dwc_occurrence(objects, event, lookup, DATASET_KEY, include_predicted = INCLUDE_PREDICTED)
emof       <- dwc_emof(objects, event, occurrence, reg, DATASET_KEY, instrument_url = project$instrument_url)
c(event = nrow(event), occurrence = nrow(occurrence), emof = nrow(emof))
# the first rows of each (all of them for a small project)
head(event, 15)
occurrence |> select(occurrenceID, eventID, scientificName, scientificNameID, taxonRank, organismQuantity,
                     identificationVerificationStatus, identificationRemarks) |> head(15)
emof |> select(eventID, occurrenceID, measurementType, measurementValue, measurementUnit, measurementTypeID, measurementUnitID, measurementValueID) |> head(15)
# the most frequent taxa by objects
occurrence |> group_by(scientificName, taxonRank) |>
  summarise(events = n_distinct(eventID), objects = sum(organismQuantity), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(desc(objects)) |> head(20)
```

## Checks

```{r}
#| label: checks
findings <- dwc_check(event, occurrence, emof)
findings
assert_dwc(findings)
# obistools on the same tables: required fields and event ids
obistools::check_fields(occurrence) |> as_tibble()
obistools::check_eventids(event)   |> as_tibble()
```

## EML

```{r}
#| label: eml
# every text comes from metadata/projects.csv (one row per project), never from another project's row
eml <- build_eml(as.list(project), event, occurrence, meta = c(
  meta[c("abstract", "license", "contact_name", "contact_email", "organization")],
  list(instrument = project$instrument)))
eml_check(eml)
stopifnot(!any(eml_check(eml)$level == "error"))
dir.create(DIR_DWCA, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
eml_path <- write_eml(eml, file.path(DIR_DWCA, "eml.xml"))
```

## The archive

```{r}
#| label: archive
a <- dwc_archive(file.path(DIR_DWCA, "build"), event, occurrence, emof, eml_path = eml_path,
                 dataset_key = DATASET_KEY, version = VERSION)
str(a)
utils::unzip(a$zip, list = TRUE)
cat(readLines(a$manifest), sep = "\n")
```

## Next, by a person

1. Review `metadata/taxa_lookup_project-<id>.csv` and the `predicted_included` finding above.
2. Upload `r basename(a$zip)` to the OBIS-USA IPT as a new resource (or a new version of one) and record the
   IPT resource id and the OBIS dataset id in the manifest; OBIS harvests the IPT and the record reaches GBIF
   through OBIS-USA.
3. Compare with EcoTaxa's own `collections/export/darwin_core` output for the same project as a cross-check.

## Lessons learned (project 4, 2026-11-10)

- **Positions of 0,0** are the usual placeholder for "unknown" (project 4's `ws21093_MR_64um`): `dwc_event()`
  now publishes them as no coordinates, the same rule as the [sample map](map_project-4.qmd). A latitude or a
  longitude of 0 alone is kept.
- **Validated only** by default: `INCLUDE_PREDICTED` turns on only when a project has no validated object (the
  demo); project 4's 951,833 predictions stay out.
- **Column names differ by instrument.** The eMoF reads `sample_tot_vol` (Zooscan) and `object_esd`; a
  PlanktoScope export has `sample_total_volume`, `sample_concentrated_sample_volume`,
  `sample_dilution_factor` and `object_equivalent_diameter` (pixels, with `process_pixel`). Volume,
  concentration and size are therefore absent for project 4 until the owner confirms units and meaning; the
  mapping belongs in `metadata/`, not guessed in code.
- **Child events have no coordinates**: occurrences on acquisition events (738 for project 4) carry the
  `no_coordinates` warning; OBIS is expected to take them from the parent sample event, to confirm.
- **Metadata per project** comes from `metadata/projects.csv`; a project without a row stops the build rather
  than borrowing the demo's text or license.
